# Toon Shaders
**Toon Shader** is a **Minecraft Resourcepack Shader** that adds [Toon Shaders or Cel Shading](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cel_shading) to Minecraft. This is a Completely Vanilla shader that requires Fabulous/Improved Transparency to function.

Check [Gallery](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/toon-shader/gallery) for images.

# Credits
